Doublade

Steel Ghost

Kalos · Generation 6

Doublade is a Steel/Ghost-type Sword Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 4.5 kg. It evolves from Honedge and into Aegislash. Its highest base stat is Defense (150), with a base stat total of 448.
